explanation: GO is always 0; D1 is usually 8, rising to 10 on the D1 just after a rare-transition trial and dropping to 3-6 after an unrewarded trial (especially two unrewarded trials in a row). D2 depends on the choice: after a2 it is about 5, or 6-7 if the transition was rare (S1 reached); after a1 it is about 3, or 1-2 if the transition was rare (S2 reached), plus about 1 if the previous trial was unrewarded.
